# Retrieve cached hotel search results
hotels = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")

# Filter hotels based on user preferences
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels,
    budget=65,
    stars=[4, 4],
    pool_present=True,
    has_room_service=True
)

# Save filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Search for scenic attractions in Fresno
attractions = search_attractions(
    city="Fresno",
    type=["Scenic"]
)

# Save attraction search results to cache
save_to_cache(key="attractions", value=attractions)

# Find nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_attractions = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save nearest attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_attractions", value=nearest_attractions)
